title: Reflecting Pool Contractor Blames Its Own Repairs, Not Vandals, for Damage
partialText: The contractor said the pool’s new blue liner peeled and tore because of “human oversight” and a flawed plan that involved layering two incompatible chemicals, documents show.

title: Court Strikes Down Trump Order to Keep an Aging Coal-Burning Plant Running
partialText: The 64-year-old Michigan power plant was set to retire. Then the Trump administration intervened in a way that overstepped its authority, a court ruled.

title: Trump’s Grand Midterm Convention Finale: ‘I’m a Little Bit Tired of Politics’
partialText: The president made clear as his convention wrapped up that he wants to carry his party through a tough midterms. He just won’t go too far out of his way to do it.

title: How Trump Is Using the Postal Service to Intervene in Elections
partialText: Our politics reporter Reid Epstein explains how the Trump administration is using the Postal Service to intervene in mail-in voting in state elections.

title: Trump’s ‘Midterm Convention’ Tried to Reach Die-Hard Republican Voters, but Lacked Oomph
partialText: The long, odd two-night TV production hoped to reach a select audience of die-hard voters (if football didn’t intercept them).

title: Influencers Invited to the Republican Midterm Convention Largely Avoided Talking About The Economy
partialText: Online media stars eager to promote President Trump and Republicans worked to find a message that would resonate with an audience that is struggling with an affordability crisis.

title: Houthis Seize a Key Red Sea Island, Threatening Yet Another Global Oil Route
partialText: The Iran-backed militia’s ground offensive has reached the Bab al-Mandab, a Red Sea strait that is a choke point for global trade.

title: Israel Destroys Underground Hezbollah Base in Southern Lebanon
partialText: The complex sat below Ali al-Taher ridge, a strategic hilltop that overlooks the region and that has seen intense fighting.

title: Trading Keggers for ‘Wellness Darties’
partialText: A new crop of college students is finding balance at daytime parties with yoga, saunas and cold plunges.

title: Elevated Inflation Keeps Pressure on Fed to Raise Rates
partialText: The odds of a quarter-point rate increase at the Federal Reserve’s meeting next week surged to 90 percent after August’s Consumer Price Index report.

title: AARP Projects 2027 Social Security COLA at 3.6%
partialText: If the AARP’s projection holds, the cost-of-living adjustment would be the largest since 2023.

title: How Did a Heart Drug With So Much Promise Fall So Flat?
partialText: Cardiologists are struggling to figure out why a drug that should have prevented heart attacks didn’t work at all.

title: The Incredible Art of Being Jeff Koons
partialText: For five decades, the artist has made sculptures that are larger-than-life — and also singularly reflective of his own.

title: Holdout Juror in Lindsay Clancy’s Mistrial Highlights a Divide in America
partialText: The nation’s reaction to the 11-1 deadlock that resulted in a mistrial for Lindsay Clancy was, like the jury itself, fiercely and unbridgeably divided.

title: How Minnesota Became the Front Line in the Fight Over Prediction Markets
partialText: The state was the first to pass a law banning Kalshi and Polymarket. A lawsuit filed by a federal agency may set a precedent on who gets to regulate them.

title: What Are Kalshi and Polymarket?
partialText: Prediction markets have taken off in popularity, drawing billions of dollars in trades. Some states have tried to ban them.

title: Are Our Expectations Too High for Democracy? Adam Przeworski Thinks So.
partialText: What is democracy, and is it in crisis?

title: This Is Really Bad
partialText: We can no longer pretend that A.I. is safe.

title: Twenty-Five Years
partialText: We look back at Sept. 11, 2001.

title: Boy, 15, Drifted for Days on an Overturned Boat Before Rescue
partialText: The teenager survived in the Bering Sea off Alaska without food or water before a fishing vessel pulled him to safety, the Coast Guard said.
